key_insight: A regularized policy mirror descent method can converge quickly even when the critic is updated with only one TD step, and this extends to a stochastic off-policy setting with provable sample complexity.
engineering_relevance: This suggests more practical reinforcement-learning solvers for large MDPs by avoiding expensive exact policy evaluation, nested loops, and trajectory resets.
method: Use policy mirror descent with a persistent critic updated by one TD step per iteration.
For the deterministic case, combine a resolvent-based auxiliary distribution with a decaying Bellman-violation correction.
For the stochastic case, analyze off-policy TD-PMD with strong convex mirror maps, finite-batch TD updates, and visitation-weighted error propagation.
